subject: *: make sessionctx.Context depend on contexts in planner and expression (#51150)
summary: Refactors context interfaces: extracts `expression.EvalContext/BuildContext` into `pkg/expression/context`, makes `planner/context.PlanContext` depend on the extracted expression context, and updates `sessionctx.Context` to embed the planner/expression context interfaces. Moves the `InfoSchemaMetaVersion` workaround interface to `pkg/infoschema/context` and updates `GetInfoSchema`/`GetDomainInfoSchema` signatures in session/sessionctx/table accordingly. Review of the diff shows type-level wiring only with equivalent method sets and no plausible correctness/SQL semantics/txn/session behavior changes introduced.
